decoder: 512D deterministic hashed bag-of-words on assistant work prose; weighted cosine kNN K=7; leave-one-task-out; action classes inspect/edit/test/execute/vcs_submit.
raw_representation: linear cumulative sum of all work-state vectors up to current state
local_corrected_representation: current + previous + top-2 cosine-similar earlier work states with geometry weight exp(-(1-cos)^2)
gate_timing: Loop-Regime Gate uses executed command history strictly before the action being predicted.
robustness: Across 12 combinations of history_k in {1,2,3} and kNN_K in {3,5,7,11}, Qwen local-corrected accuracy exceeded Raw in 12/12 combinations; same direction held in the 300 strong-loop states in 12/12 combinations.
engineering_result: Strong-loop diagnosis and representation utility are separate variables. The gate should route to a loop-specific breaker while retaining useful local state, rather than automatically reverting to Raw cumulative history.
